# AI Stupid Level

> AI Stupid Level (ASL) runs the same coding, reasoning and tool-use tasks against large language models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI (Kimi) and Z.ai (GLM) on a fixed schedule, tracks each model against its own past to detect degradation, and offers the Smart Router: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes each request on those results, with the customer's own provider keys and no markup on tokens.

The pages below are rendered from live data, so figures change through the day; each page states its own "as of" time. The methodology is public. The test tasks are private.

## Rankings
- [AI leaderboard](https://aistupidlevel.info/leaderboard): the first ten places on the Combined, Coding, Reasoning and Tool use boards over the last 24 hours, with statistical ties
- [Best AI model for each job](https://aistupidlevel.info/best-ai-model): the leader for coding, reasoning, agents, value and speed
- [Best LLM for coding](https://aistupidlevel.info/best-llm-for-coding)
- [Best LLM for reasoning](https://aistupidlevel.info/best-llm-for-reasoning)
- [Best AI model for agents and tool calling](https://aistupidlevel.info/best-ai-model-for-agents)
- [Best value AI model](https://aistupidlevel.info/best-value-ai-model)
- [Fastest AI model](https://aistupidlevel.info/fastest-ai-model)

## Models and comparisons
- [All models](https://aistupidlevel.info/models): every model on the board by vendor; each model has a page at /models/<slug> with its score, place, price and drift state
- [OpenAI models](https://aistupidlevel.info/models/openai), [Claude models](https://aistupidlevel.info/models/anthropic), [Gemini models](https://aistupidlevel.info/models/google), [DeepSeek models](https://aistupidlevel.info/models/deepseek), [Kimi models](https://aistupidlevel.info/models/kimi), [GLM models](https://aistupidlevel.info/models/glm)
- [Compare models](https://aistupidlevel.info/compare): head-to-head pages at /compare/<model-a>-vs-<model-b>, slugs in alphabetical order

## Degradation, drift and status
- [AI degradation tracker](https://aistupidlevel.info/ai-degradation-tracker): every model, suite by suite, with each drift detector's state and the canary's dated alarms
- [AI nerf tracker](https://aistupidlevel.info/ai-nerf-tracker): what "nerfed" means, how the check works and where to check each model family
- [AI drift detection](https://aistupidlevel.info/ai-drift-detection): the method (a Page-Hinkley detector per suite, an hourly canary)
- [Is your AI getting worse?](https://aistupidlevel.info/is-ai-getting-worse), with pages for [ChatGPT](https://aistupidlevel.info/is-chatgpt-getting-worse), [Claude](https://aistupidlevel.info/is-claude-getting-worse), [Gemini](https://aistupidlevel.info/is-gemini-getting-worse) and [DeepSeek](https://aistupidlevel.info/is-deepseek-getting-worse)
- [AI provider status](https://aistupidlevel.info/status): one real completion to each provider every 10 minutes

## Smart Router
- [Smart Router](https://aistupidlevel.info/router): what it is, the routing modes and the rules it applies
- [Router documentation](https://aistupidlevel.info/router/docs): endpoints, parameters and response headers
- [AI router and LLM router, explained](https://aistupidlevel.info/ai-router)
- [LLM routing by task](https://aistupidlevel.info/llm-routing-by-task)
- [LLM fallback routing](https://aistupidlevel.info/llm-fallback-routing)
- [LLM cost routing](https://aistupidlevel.info/llm-cost-routing)

- [Model routing for coding agents](https://aistupidlevel.info/llm-routing-for-coding-agents)
- [Integrations](https://aistupidlevel.info/router/integrations): Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Continue, Aider, OpenCode, n8n, LangChain, Zed, Open WebUI and LibreChat
